parameters.help_en:
Fields is an array of field names used to filter non-private fields (prefixed with an underscore) in the Metadata field returned by this operation. By default, if Fields is empty, all non-private fields in the Metadata field are returned. If you want the returned Metadata field to contain only specific non-private fields, such as title, pass title here.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
Fields是一个字段名数组，用于对本接口返回的Metadata字段中的非私有Field（以_下划线为前缀）进行过滤。默认Fields为空时，Metadata字段中的所有非私有的Field都会返回。若您希望返回的Metadata字段只包含指定的非私有Field，比如只包含title，则此处传入title即可。

默认值为空

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

The file ID, which is the FileId returned by the AddFile operation. You do not need to pass this field for data query or image Q&A knowledge bases. You must pass this field for document search or audio/video search knowledge bases. You can also obtain the file ID by going to the Files tab on the Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center) page and clicking the ID icon next to the file name. You can use the file ID to filter the returned chunks. Default value: empty.


</props>

If you use the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio SDK of the following versions or later, we recommend that you use the FileId field to specify the file ID. If you use the Swift Alibaba Cloud Model Studio SDK, continue to use this field.

Metadata.description_en:
<props="china">

The metadata map of the text chunk.

The file_path field in the metadata map of a document search knowledge base is meaningless. Do not use it in your business code.

When you retrieve a document search knowledge base, if a chunk contains an image, the image URL is returned in the image_url field of the metadata map, along with an expiration time.

When you retrieve an audio/video search knowledge base, if a chunk contains audio, the audio URL is returned in the audio_url field of the metadata map, along with an expiration time.

When you retrieve an audio/video search knowledge base, if a chunk contains a video, the video URL is returned in the video_url field of the metadata map, along with an expiration time.

</props>
<props="intl">

The metadata map of the text chunk.

The file_path field in the metadata map of a document search knowledge base is meaningless. Do not use it in your business code.

When you retrieve a document search knowledge base, if a chunk contains an image, the image URL is returned in the image_url field of the metadata map, along with an expiration time.

</props>
Metadata.description_zh:
<props="china">

文本切片的元数据Map。

文档搜索类知识库的元数据Map中`file_path`字段无意义，请勿在业务代码中使用。

检索文档搜索类识库时，若切片包含图片，将通过元数据 Map 中` image_url `字段透出，并附有过期时间。

检索音视频搜索类知识库时，若切片包含音频，将通过元数据 Map 中` audio_url `字段透出，并附有过期时间。

检索音视频搜索类知识库时，若切片包含视频，将通过元数据 Map 中` video_url `字段透出，并附有过期时间。

</props>
<props="intl">

文本切片的元数据Map。

文档搜索类知识库的元数据Map中`file_path`字段无意义，请勿在业务代码中使用。

检索文档搜索类知识库时，若切片包含图片，将通过元数据 Map 中` image_url `字段透出，并附有过期时间。

</props>
